correctness.rationale: The formula follows by a bijection from proper cycle colourings to closed ternary +/-1 edge-increment words, character orthogonality for the closure, and exact evaluation of factors as 2 or -1. A three-term (-2)-power sum vanishes exactly for occupancies (a,a,a+1), and the fixed-terminal-colour multinomial count gives \(n!/(a!^2(a+1)!)\). The hyperplane-frequency bijection and Fourier diagonalization give rank \(3^{n-1}\) minus this count. Nonzero multipliers are multiples of three. The included checker.py independently performs full cyclotomic transforms on 88,560 frequencies for \(3\le n\le10\), matching every coefficient and nullity. There is no inference from finite computations to the theorem.

value.rationale: The indicator of proper cycle colourings is a canonical constraint set in a finite abelian product group. Global translation forces one baseline Fourier annihilator, but whether it gives the entire support and hence full convolution rank is not answered by chromatic counts or low-degree covariances. The theorem isolates an unexpected modulo-three resonance, classifies every extra zero, and gives an exact multinomial nullity for infinitely many lengths. This is a structural all-n harmonic-analysis classification, not a finite table, normalization check or cosmetic parameter substitution.
